text:
maria: Hey team — need deal-desk approval for Orion Health, asking for a bespoke first-year package. Request: 25% off list on a 12mo commit (~$1.2M ARR list), plus $50k onboarding credit. They insisted due to tight evaluation window and competitive pricing.
aj: Ok can you drop quick rationale + renewal signal? need to justify above standard POC concession. cc @deal-desk-bot for policy link
deal-desk-bot: Reminder: standard enterprise max discretionary discount = 15% without VP signoff. Onboarding credits typically capped at $25k unless escalated. See https://redwood.internal/docs/deal-desk/policy
maria: Rationale — large strategic health system, likely to expand into 3 product areas in year 2, procurement requires signed PO this quarter, competitor offering 20% + free pilot infra. Sales motion = PLG->pilot->enterprise. Renewal signal: customer committed to explore 3x seats after pilot if clinical eval passes.
diego: Finance — need expected ARR and gross margin impact. If list = $1.2M, 25% means net $900k first year. With $50k credit effective = $850k. What's the required CC/terms? prepay?
maria: They can do 12mo commit on NET30, procurement prefers invoice terms but we can negotiate prepay for better economics.
kate: Legal — any SSO / data residency asks that change T&Cs? also onboarding credit needs to be reflected as one-time invoice credit. If we change SLA or indemnities we need legal to review.
samira: Sales ops — from quota/comp side, any above-15% needs VP approval and we need to record exception reason in SFDC. Also need partner discount checkbox cleared.
aj: Based on risk I can sign off up to 15% + $25k onboarding credit. For anything above, need Nina (VP Sales) approval + finance OK on margins.
maria: I understand. Customer pushing hard — losing them would likely delay our health vertical momentum. Can we propose a middle ground and ask customer to prepay 6mo?
diego: If they prepay 6mo we can extend to 20% and up to $35k credit, margins acceptable. Without prepay, 25% + $50k drops margin below threshold.
maria: I'll ask for 6mo prepay option in negotiation. If they refuse, I need to escalate.
aj: OK escalate to @nina for final sign-off. Adding deal link in SFDC now.
nina: Quick read — thanks for context. Condition: approve up to 22% off + $30k onboarding credit if they sign 12mo commit and net-60 invoice schedule OK. Need a 1-line business case in the deal notes (strategic health system, pipeline expansion x3, competitive replace risk).
maria: Accepted. I'll take 22% / $30k and add the business case note. Thanks! :thumbsup:
diego: Finance logged the margin waiver. Please include final PO and invoicing instructions in the sales handoff.
samira: I'll update comp exception and set alert for renewal contact 90d before EOY.
aj: Filed escalation + approval in the deal record. Closing loop once contract signed.
maria: Ev's on call with procurement tomorrow 9am PT, will push the prepay/12mo terms and update here after the call.
_nina reacted with :white_check_mark:_
